mode: Manual UI replay; this file performs no automatic changes

fictional_inputs.subject_note: TRAINING ONLY - Unit app walkthrough note on this fictional draft. No actual hours, work, expense, or payment claim.

historical_observation.purpose: Readback from the recorded example; never force an ID, date, time or hours into a fresh installation

guards: Use only an isolated fictional training department and an authorized Unit session.
Find the deployment and crew through the normal UI; resolve their actual returned IDs.
An existing editable training draft with the intended subjects is required. Stop if it is submitted, signed, locked, missing or belongs to another scope.
Read existing entries before editing. Do not add duplicate hours, entries, expenses or usage readings.
Change only the intended training subject note. If that note already matches, reopen and verify it instead of saving again.
Do not invoke Submit report, Sign as crew boss, agency signing, Validate, Draft F-42 from time reports, or any approval/payment action.
Preserve unit response status, active call selection, other notes, all hours and unrelated records.
normal_replay: Open Deployments and choose the exact fictional deployment; read its active context and crew.
Open Time, choose the existing training date and intended scope, and inspect the existing draft.
Compare subjects, hours and report status. Change only the crew subject note if permitted, then choose Save entries.
Read any unresolved warnings. Leave and reopen the same draft; verify its saved note and unchanged Draft status and hours.
Compare My time and Whole deployment without creating another report.
Review the existing Expenses form, empty Usage unit choices, and F-42 review status without adding values or invoking validation/generation/signing.
scope: A note-only saved-draft exercise. It does not establish actual work, spending, submitted reports, signatures, validation, approval or payment.
